meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 在已存在的 AKS 集群上按顺序执行六步：校验集群、安装 AI Runway 控制器与 CRD、评估 GPU、选择并安装推理 provider、部署第一个模型、最后总结。每步报告集群状态，安装或部署前先征求你的确认。
howto.when: 当你提到“setup AI Runway”、“deploy model to AKS”等关键词，或想从零在已有 AKS 集群上搭建 AI Runway、部署模型时触发。集群必须已存在，否则先转给 azure-kubernetes。

say.text: 帮我在现有 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway 控制器
say.note: 从第 1 步集群校验开始依次执行

say.text: 看看我集群里的 GPU 能跑什么模型
say.note: 进行 GPU 评估并给出 provider 建议

say.text: 从第 4 步继续 AI Runway 安装
say.note: 跳到 provider 安装，默认前面已完成

howto.what_en: On an existing AKS cluster it runs six ordered steps: verify cluster, install AI Runway controller/CRDs, assess GPUs, install an inference provider, deploy a first model, summarize. It reports state each step and asks before installs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "setup AI Runway" or "deploy model to AKS", or when you want AI Runway set up on an existing AKS cluster. A cluster must exist, else it hands off to azure-kubernetes.
